title: ICDS 2026 Travel Grant (International Celiac Disease Symposium)
description: A travel grant to attend the 21st International Celiac Disease Symposium (ICDS 2026) in Melbourne, Australia, November 17-20, 2026 -- the first time this long-running biennial symposium has been held in the Southern Hemisphere. Awardees receive free conference registration plus a contribution toward offsetting travel and accommodation costs. Eligibility runs on two tracks: delegates from Low- and Middle-Income Countries (as designated by the World Bank), regardless of career stage, or current full-time students and early-career researchers from any country. All applicants must have submitted an abstract for oral or poster presentation through the conference's online submission portal and are expected to actually present it. Applications (a one-page letter of motivation plus CV) are due 14 August 2026, midnight AEST; recipients are notified by 18 September 2026.
org: International Society for the Study of Celiac Disease (ISSCD)
visaNote: This is conference attendance, not employment; delegates should confirm visitor-visa requirements for Australia based on their nationality.
